people.name: Solomon's_Portico
people.line: Colonnade in Jerusalem's temple where apostles taught

translations.web: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
translations.bsb: While the man clung to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade.
translations.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
translations.asv: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
